body.name: \((\pi^*_{n,c},\widehat\pi_{n,c})\)
body.construction: \(\pi^*_{n,c,j}=q_{c,b_j}(Ru_{n,j})\) and \(\widehat\pi_{n,c,j}=q_{c,b_j}(R\widehat u_{n,j})\), where \(\widehat u_n=\sqrt n\,\widehat\Delta_n=u_n+E_n\). The learned lottery is therefore \(\mathcal F_n^{\mathrm{obs}}\)-measurable although its oracle comparator is not observed.
